metadata.note: Web-discovered reference (direction: hospital ICU patient monitor). Initial capture showed a cardiac-arrest alarm state; a live re-capture with vitals params (?hr=78&spo2=97&...) shows the steady state (ALL CLEAR band, live traces confirmed by pixel measurement: 5.3k green + 5.4k cyan px in waveform lanes).

frame.notes: Monitor enclosure and header/sidebar panels: closed 1px blue-gray rectangles, ~8px radius, flat (no glow). Restrained squared clinical language.

cards.notes: Scenario cards and sidebar cards: closed 1px blue-gray rectangles, 6-7px radius, dark slate fill (#0f181d family), no glow, no brackets.

dividers.notes: Thin subdued blue-gray rules separate waveform lanes and readout rows; fine ~1px gridlines (#16222b family) inside lanes.

inputs.notes: Sidebar vital inputs: near-black fill (#0b1016), 1px blue-gray border, ~4px radius, bold near-white values.

activeIndicators.notes: No left accent bars. Active/selected state = accent-colored text (green BED 04, checked controls pale blue #29dfff family, bright value blocks). Status colors carry state: green normal, cyan O2, yellow resp, red critical.

keyElements.description: three stacked lanes (ECG II green, PLETH cyan, RESP/CO2 yellow) over a fine low-contrast blue-gray grid
right column per-lane: colored label, huge value, muted limit/unit text (HR 76 green, SpO2 96 cyan + PI, RR 14 yellow)
full-width status band: blue-gray ALL CLEAR steady state, saturated red #d84351 band with white mono text in critical state
green BED 04, muted TRAINING / DEMO, right-aligned digital clock, fullscreen icon
two-column labeled numeric inputs (HR, SpO2, Sys, Dia, RR, Temp, EtCO2, Speed)
stacked selectable clinical scenario cards (Stable post-op, Hypoxic resp. distress, ...)
ECG logo tile (green/yellow/cyan), SIMULATION ONLY eyebrow, SimVitals title, Randomize + green Save PNG buttons
